Give AI your paid search export and analytics report and it works out a ChatGPT bid ceiling.

In this clip Hannah and I cover two jobs to hand to AI for ChatGPT ads. A marketing lead should care because a new channel can hide inside a blended total.

The first takes your paid search export and analytics channel report. It works out revenue per visit for each channel and gives you a bid ceiling per campaign, flagging any where the sample is too small to trust. The second is a weekly routine that pulls paid ChatGPT onto its own line and warns you if spend rises while sales stay at zero.

The prompts are in the show notes. The podcast voices are AI-generated.

Full episode and article at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/chatgpt-ads-returns-vs-google-search-study/
clips.text: Right, so what do you hand to AI? First one. Get AI on this, working out your parity price. Give it your paid search export and your analytics channel report, revenue and sessions for both channels. It works out revenue per visit for each and gives you a bid ceiling per campaign, flagging any where the sample's too small to trust. Second, a weekly check so the new channel can't hide inside a blended total. Set it as a weekly routine. It reads the channel report, pulls those ads out on their own line, and gives you sessions, sales and cost per sale against paid search, with a warning if spend rises while sales stay at zero.
